notes: Task-scoped recovery and dashboard Follow: invalid source, malformed local JSON and failed edits no longer ban a structured-task builder for the rest of the job. One bounded same-model correction now covers failed exact edits and empty changes; exact-search corrections request complete approved files. Static repairs carry explicit defects and scoped output instructions. Account authentication/quota, transport policy, consent, frozen checks and global call/repair limits remain enforced. Dashboard Follow centers running, completed and failed observed steps, resumes at the latest activity when rechecked and retains events while layout loads. New request-start history shows actual model invocation activity. Fixture/browser checks verify controller and viewport behavior, not live-model quality or restored provider quota. Resume the saved Tiny Wins build after updating; do not approve a new plan or mark it verified prematurely.
